messages:
tara (prod): quick decision needed — we're shipping follow-on for the smart-replies launch. we have ~2 dev-weeks and 3 competing asks (bug bundle, perf tweaks, small new enhancement). want a fast call: bugs vs bets?

sam (eng): tl;dr: user-reported regressions on long-thread tokenization. high likelihood of more customer tickets if we don't patch.

anya (design): the enhancement (context-aware suggestions) is a tiny UX change but moves nps on the playbook by ~.3 in prototype. low engineering surface but higher spec time.

luca (cs): two enterprise customers escalated about occasional hallucination on signature lines — they want patching prioritized. also asking for visibility if we delay.

joel (sre): SLO note — latency spike correlated with current batch config when sequence_len > 1024. perf tweak might reduce cost by 8% and fix CPU pressure. could be medium risk.

tara (prod): ok here are three options, pick what you want me to sign off on. react with :one: :two: :three: or reply.

```
1) Bug bundle (1.5w): prioritize regressions & hallucination fixes, small test harness, canary. preserves enterprise trust.
2) Perf tune (2w): change batching + KV cache settings, cut token cost ~8%, requires A/B rollout and perf regression tests.
3) Small enhancement (1w): land context-aware suggestions, higher NPS but risk of introducing new tokenization edge cases.
```

sam (eng): my vote = 1. patching reduces ticket churn and is low-risk to roll out.

anya (design): 3 if we can parallelize spec work with dev on 1. if not, 1.

luca (cs): +1 for 1. customers already on the phone.

joel (sre): i'm neutral between 1 & 2. if we pick 1, let us run canary with tighter observability (trace sampling up).

tara (prod): decision: go with option 1 (bugs) + start spec work for 3 in parallel if we can spare a half-day of design sync. action items:
- sam: cut the bug bundle PR and assign test owners (due EOD tomorrow)
- joel: enable high-sample tracing in canary, rollback playbook ready
- anya: draft 1-2 screen mocks for enhancement so we can land quicker if capacity frees up
- luca: communicate to the two customers with ETA and mitigation steps

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: smart-replies-bugfix-v1 -> staging-canary (will post status)

tara (prod): thanks all. I'll book a 15m standup tomorrow 10:30 to check canary health and re-evaluate perf tuning slot. :thumbsup:
